targeted_carry_pytest.command: uv run --locked --python 3.11 pytest -q tests/test_carry_dated_replay.py tests/test_carry_dated_policy.py tests/test_carry_dated_governance.py tests/test_carry_dated_domain.py

ruff.command: uv run --locked --python 3.11 ruff check src/btcquant/domain/carry_dated_policy.py src/btcquant/research/carry_dated_replay.py tests/test_carry_dated_replay.py tests/test_carry_dated_policy.py tests/test_carry_dated_governance.py

mechanics_covered: dated expiry selection and stable decision identity across repeated inputs; source book hash changes decision identity
observed depth-walked entry and expiry spot exit; official daily/expiry settlements telescope to entry-to-expiry cash PnL
missing, duplicate, corrected, and pre-event settlement evidence; stale, late, and not-yet-received books
protective trigger debits short losses since last official settlement, never credits short gains, and supports negative derivative cash
protective close covers future first, then sells spot; partial depth and amount-step residual are explicit
spot entry and exit fee currency sensitivity BASE versus QUOTE, including BTC consumed, quote cash fees, and realized PnL
terminal 5% spot/index basis sensitivity is reported separately and is never treated as covered by the 2% admission reserve

limitations.fixture_scope: mechanical proof only; no portfolio fills, no observed completed carry cycle, no profitability evidence
limitations.live_paper_fee_scenario: The current runner assumes BASE for routed spot fees at entry and exit; this is explicitly a PAPER assumption because public source data do not establish the debit asset.
